title_en: Call for Students to Observe the Fifth Nuri Rocket Launch
summary: Undergraduate and graduate students enrolled in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who wish to observe the fifth Nuri rocket launch at the Naro Space Center should send their student ID number and contact details by email by 11:00 on Friday, 4 September 2026; the email address is given in the original notice. One student per university will be selected internally. According to the notice's information section, the form in the attachment must be completed and returned to the email address in the attachment by 17:00 on Friday, 4 September 2026; anyone who does not reply by then will be excluded from selection.
applies_to: Undergraduate and graduate students currently enrolled in the Department of Aerospace Engineering who are interested in observing the launch. Participation is voluntary. Only one student per university will be selected, through internal selection within the university.

dates.what: Deadline to send your student ID number and contact details by email to express interest
Reply deadline: return the completed form to the email address given in the attachment; no reply by this time means exclusion from selection
Scheduled launch date of the fifth Nuri rocket (subject to change; a new notice will be issued if it changes)

conditions: Only undergraduate and graduate students currently enrolled in the Department of Aerospace Engineering are eligible.
Only one student will be selected from each university, through internal selection within the university.
Anyone who does not reply by 17:00 on Friday, 4 September 2026 will be excluded from selection.
The launch date may change; if it does, a new notice will be issued.
steps: Send your student ID number and contact details by email by 11:00 a.m. on Friday, 4 September 2026 (the email address is given in the original notice).
Read the attachment to the original notice, which contains the contact person, contact details, the form and the email address for replies (the attachment was not provided and has not been read).
Complete the form in the attachment and return it to the email address given in the attachment by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, 4 September 2026.
translation:
Call for Undergraduate and Graduate Students to Observe the Fifth Nuri Rocket Launch

On the occasion of the fifth launch of the Nuri rocket, the Korea AeroSpace Administration intends to offer undergraduate and graduate students in aerospace engineering departments in Korea the opportunity to observe the launch. Interested students are asked to send their student ID number and contact details to [email] by 11:00 a.m. on Friday, 4 September 2026 (26.09.04.(금) 오전 11시까지). (The email address is given in the original notice.)

< Information >

A. Scheduled launch date: Wednesday, 7 October 2026*

B. Location: Naro Space Center (Goheung, South Jeolla Province)

C. Eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students currently enrolled in the Department of Aerospace Engineering

D. Number selected: One student per university (selected internally within each university)

E. Contact person: See attachment

F. Contact details: See attachment

G. Reply deadline: By 5:00 p.m. on Friday, 4 September 2026 (anyone who does not reply within this period will be excluded from selection)

H. How to apply: Complete the file and return it to the email address given in the attachment

* A new notice will be issued if the date changes.

(Note: The attachment referred to in this notice was not provided and has not been read.)
